description:
The 'legacy-finance-app' project contains a file 'CurrencyConfig.java' that was originally created on Windows using Windows-1252 encoding. IntelliJ IDEA is currently interpreting it as UTF-8, causing special currency symbols (Euro, Pound, Yen) to display as garbage characters or replacement symbols ().

Your task is to:
1. Open 'src/main/java/com/legacy/finance/CurrencyConfig.java'.
2. Fix the display by reloading the file in the correct encoding (Windows-1252).
3. Convert the file to UTF-8 so it is saved with standard encoding.
4. Change the line separators for the project files from Windows (CRLF) to Unix (LF).
5. Configure the Project Encoding settings to UTF-8 to prevent future issues.
6. Verify the fix by running the unit tests (CurrencyTest).
